assets.title: Sloped Eave Snow Cap
assets.description: One original closed thick low-poly snow cap with a broad gently uneven sloped upper blanket and a continuous rounded downturned front lip, one static prop and one editable monolithic mesh. Its complete finite underside attachment rectangle lies on source z=0.80+0.40y m, x=[-0.95,0.95] m, y=[0.02,0.72] m; the roof rises 0.40 m per metre toward +Y, slope 21.801409 degrees. The outward underside normal is (0,0.371391,-0.928477); the required matching support has the opposite normal. The source origin (0,0,0) is a design datum, not ground contact. All asset vertices lie on or above the declared sloped support plane. The continuous snow lip extends toward -Y outside the bounded contact patch and hangs below its front elevation. An external matching sloped support is required; the temporary QA support never enters the asset, native scene or formal images. Three opaque constant PBR snow colours; no texture, transmission, scene, house, roof, animation or variants. Metres, source Z up, front -Y. Static stylised appearance only: no snow or ice material physics, melting, sliding, climate or weather simulation, snow load, adhesion, stability, structural or human safety, manufacture or construction/installation claim. No previous cottage or shop-house tile-roof fit, universal eave interface, arbitrary roof pitch, seamless repetition or length compatibility is asserted.
